# `Q-13-16` — Announcement has no content

> `website.announcement` is set, but there is no text to show, so no
> banner is rendered.

## What this means

An announcement banner needs content. It can be given as a string,

```yaml
website:
  announcement: "This site is in beta."
```

or as the `content` key of a map that also sets options:

```yaml
website:
  announcement:
    content: "This site is in beta."
    type: warning
```

This warning fires when the value has no usable content: it is
`true`, a map with no `content` key, or a blank string.

## Why this happens

- **`announcement: true`** — the option is not an on/off switch; the
  value is the content itself.
- **A map without `content`** — for example only `type:` and `icon:`
  were set, or the key was misspelled (`text:`, `message:`).
- **An empty string**, often left behind while editing.

## How to fix

Give the announcement text, as a string or as `content:`. To turn
the banner off, for the whole site or for one page, set
`announcement: false` instead; that is silent.
